entities.name: Zurbit
entities.description: Relno's faithful one-eyed homunculus attendant on Shandalar.

entities.name: Relno
entities.description: A wizard on Shandalar whose tower is robbed by merfolk.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: A group of reef-dwelling merfolk who steal from land-dwellers along the Kapsho Sea.

entities.name: Kapsho Sea
entities.description: The sea along whose shores the merfolk steal.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane where Relno and Zurbit live.

events.summary: Zurbit discovers Relno's tower ransacked by merfolk.
events.quote: The bookshelves in Relno 's tower were bare, papers were everywhere, flasks and beakers lay broken

events.summary: Zurbit rows Pip out to the merfolk reef and tosses a threatening message in a flask overboard.
events.quote: hastily scrawled a message, announcing that the merfolk should give back the stolen goods or they would be sorry

events.summary: Zurbit feeds Pip a potion that makes the cat grow to the size of a small whale over the merfolk reef.
events.quote: while Pip slowly grew to the size of a small whale

events.summary: Relno returns and Zurbit passes the damage off as letting in sea air.
events.quote: Zurbit just said that he was letting in a little sea air

relations.quote: Zurbit is Relno 's faithful homunculus attendant on Shandalar .
these finny folk were robbers and cutthroats
